name: Venmo consumer homepage by venmo.com
description: Venmo's consumer landing page alternates airy, typography-led white sections with saturated full-bleed colour bands — a rounded sky-blue hero card, an indigo rewards band, an orange-to-yellow gradient business card, and a blue app-download band — each carrying exactly one message. Hierarchy is driven by an oversized bold grotesque with tight tracking, pill-shaped CTAs that flip from black-on-white to white-on-colour, and huge vertical padding between the two-column Debit/Credit/Checkout rows. Superscript footnote markers thread through the marketing copy and balloon into a dense regulatory footer, a signature fintech pattern; ghosted statement headlines ('Send. Split. Gift.', 'Purchase crypto') act as scroll-paced interstitials between the colour bands.
